applicability: where applicable, relevant European and international standards

expected_evidence: record of the security level judged against the risks

note: No party is the subject of 'shall'; the measures shall ensure the level of security. 'where applicable' is read as qualifying the standards, not the state-of-the-art or the cost. 'The first subparagraph' means the take-measures passage in this same paragraph. Discovery hints name plausible artifacts. They are not proof that a measure is appropriate, proportionate, or in place, and they are not proof that a Member State has transposed this duty.

references.law_text:
Taking into account the state-of-the-art and, where applicable, relevant
European and international standards, as well as the cost of implementation,
the measures referred to in the first subparagraph shall ensure a level of
security of network and information systems appropriate to the risks posed.

remediation_hint: Look for how the security level of the paragraph 1 measures was judged against the risks, including state-of-the-art, cost, and standards where applicable.
scope: the state-of-the-art and, where applicable, relevant European and international standards, as well as the cost of implementation
